Faculty Advertisement
Friday, 22 September 2017
6353 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts.
1. Professor in TB and Chest (1) and Psychiatry (1)
2. Associate Professors in Radiodiagnosis (1) and Radiotherapy (1)
3. Assistant Professor in Medicine (2), TB and Chest (1), Ophthalmology (1), Orthopedics (1) and Surgery (2)
4. Senior Residents in TB and Chest (1), Orthopedics (1) Surgery (1), Obstetrics and Gynaecology(1),  Radiodiagnosis (2) and Radiotherapy (2)
Applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience certificates/testimonials must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by
20/10/2017
. The appointments would be adhoc till the next Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience : As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale : As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details please contact:
Phone: 07152 -284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203) fax: 07152-284333, 284220
Email:
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Website: www.mgims.ac.in
